title: Scope.
officialText:
This chapter shall govern the design, construction and installation of mechanical exhaust systems, including exhaust
systems serving clothes dryers and cooking appliances; hazardous exhaust systems; dust, stock and refuse conveyor systems; subslab soil
exhaust systems; smoke control systems; energy recovery ventilation systems; and other systems specified in Section 502.
